content:
🔥 Ravana is not dead. He is living among us. Sometimes, inside us.

Every Dussehra, we burn an effigy of Ravana. But have we ever tried burning the Ravana within ourselves?

👹 His 10 heads still exist in our modern world:

• Anger that destroys relationships 
• Greed that makes money more important than values 
• Ego that refuses to apologise 
• Jealousy that steals our peace 
• Power that corrupts our judgement 
• And attachment, lust, laziness, materialism and illusion that slowly consume us.

🏹 Lord Rama’s victory was not just about defeating a demon. It was about the triumph of righteousness over evil.

Today, our biggest battle is not with the world. It is with our own weaknesses.

✨ Because true victory begins when we conquer what is wrong within us.

This Dussehra, which head of your Ravana are you ready to destroy first? 🔥
